command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=$PATH:/opt/conda/bin TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
grep -E ' fetch\.py$' pins.sha256 | sha256sum -c || { echo "FAIL: fetch.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
python3 -u fetch.py /tmp/out 2>&1 | tee /tmp/out/fetch.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = 0 && grep -q 'FETCH OK' /tmp/out/fetch.log || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
